analysis:
Reviewed unit 0's local assessment against the replayed CHANGELOG.md BASE lines 2650–2739 and canonical threat index, including the full supplied T-041 definition. The replay is incomplete: two source units, including the reported changed HEAD documentation, are omitted. The visible BASE material records historical inference, token admission, encryption/billing tests, release controls and Secure Enclave behavior; it does not independently establish a new regression. Changelog assertions and the prior assessment are not implementation proof, so no concrete finding is supported.
Material integration questions remain unresolved. The local assessment reports new desktop loopback control, dashboard credentials, Electron, updates and a preview API in CHANGELOG.md HEAD 87–126. Verify that documentation and the corresponding authentication, origin/renderer isolation, token/logout and artifact-verification implementations against TB-003, A-008, T-013 and T-053; determine whether the threat model needs new boundaries. Reported verified-load hash caching at HEAD 45–46 needs manifest binding and file-race validation against A-004, T-012 and T-027. Expanded tool/JSON/media acceptance and memory accounting require validation of output withholding, decoder bounds, cancellation and reservation release (TB-007, T-007, T-010, T-050). Coordinator capability/refusal compatibility remains an external contract, not evidence of a deployed routing failure.
T-041 explicitly excludes a production resident-RAM cache. The local assessment identifies contrary historical changelog wording outside the changed ranges; without changed source, that drift cannot be attributed to this PR. Obtain the omitted HEAD/patch evidence and relevant implementations to resolve these security conclusions. This review does not clear those unverified surfaces or claim an implementation audit.
